en: Black‑and‑white vintage beach view showing a wide sandy shore crowded with sunbathers, several long wooden piers extending into a calm bay, and a excursion boat on the water. Trees frame the upper edge of the image, and low hills lie across the bay. In the lower right corner, printed text in Cyrillic and Latin characters labels the scene as a beach in the city then named Stalin.
